citations.quote: "If breakage of glass is caused by a collision, you may elect to have it treated as loss caused by collision. Repair of a windshield chip without replacement is paid with no deductible."
"Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: ... breakage of glass."

output.reasoning: The claim involves a windshield chip caused by a rock kicked up by a truck. Under [COMP-2], glass breakage caused by a collision can be elected to be treated as collision loss, and the repair of a windshield chip is paid with no deductible. Although [COMP-1] classifies breakage of glass as other than collision, [COMP-2] explicitly allows election to treat it as collision when the breakage is caused by a collision. No exclusions apply to this type of damage.
